g.text: ESP32 TRI-PROTOCOL BRIDGE (BLE 4.2 / IR / RF) // 940nm IR (38 kHz) // 433.92 MHz RF INTERFACE
CIRCUIT A: HIGH-POWER OPTICAL IR EMITTER DRIVER (38 kHz MODULATED)
CIRCUIT B: LM3046 NPN ARRAY // 433.92 MHz RF REMOTE INTERFACE
10 kΩ pull-downs eliminate GPIO boot float states to prevent RF transmitter latching. 470 Ω base limiter on 2N2222 saturates optical pulse driver for 940 nm IR carrier without thermal sag.
